slug: 2025-04-12 Cote d'Ivoire - Registre Social Unique (RSU) operationalisation, 200,000+ households

CIV.note: The document names no other system checking people against the national ID.

facts.fact: Cote d'Ivoire is operationalising its Registre Social Unique, a single registry of poor and vulnerable households to be shared with social programmes for targeting, with more than 200,000 households in the process of registration through the SIG-RSU system (BCP Filets Sociaux).

systems.owner: BCP Filets Sociaux, Ministere de la Cohesion Nationale
